title: Finite Hermite sum representative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a finite set of multi-indices in $\mathbb N^n$, and assign a real coefficient $c_\alpha$ to each multi-index. Under standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$, the function represented in $L^2$ by the finite sum of the corresponding Hermite functions, with coefficients $c_\alpha$, agrees almost everywhere with the pointwise sum $x\mapsto\sum_{\alpha\in S}c_\alpha H_\alpha(x)$, where $H_\alpha$ denotes the multivariate Hermite function.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of multi-indices in $\mathbb N^n$
a real coefficient function $c$ on $\mathbb N^n$
